name: BUY YOUR CARD / SUBSTITUTION POKER
description: Buy Your Card (also known as Substitution) is a stud poker variant where players can pay to exchange cards for better ones. Players are dealt 5 cards (2 down, 3 up) and can buy replacement cards from four options at different prices. High-low game with declaration.

content.text: Buy Your Card (also known as Substitution) is a stud poker variant where players can pay to exchange cards for better ones. Players are dealt 5 cards (2 down, 3 up) and can buy replacement cards from four options at different prices. High-low game with declaration.

Buy Your Card is a poker variant that emerged as part of the family of stud poker games with buying mechanics. These games became popular in home games and private poker clubs as alternatives to standard stud and draw poker.
2-6 players (Buy Your Card); up to 10 (Substitution variant)
52-card deck, poker chips for betting and buying

Each player gets 5 cards: 2 face down (hole cards) and 3 face up. Dealer places 3 cards face up in a row and the deck face down at the end. Card prices: furthest=1 unit, middle=2 units, nearest deck=3 units, top of deck (unknown)=4 units.

items.text: Substitution: Up to 10 players. Cards are not offered for sale; each player in turn either stands pat or discards one card and is dealt a replacement (face down if replacing hole card, face up if replacing upcard). Three substitution rounds, each followed by betting. Declaration and showdown as in Buy Your Card.
House rules: Local or house variations for betting limits, ante size, or number of buy rounds.
